questions.question: Which one of the following landscapes is NOT formed by the sea-water?
questions.solution:
**Answer: option 4) Cirque.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Cirque** landscape is **NOT **formed by the sea- water.
 
• A Cirque is an amphitheater-like valley formed by glacial erosion.
 
• A cirque is a steep-walled, semicircular hollow found in mountainous regions. 
 
• Cirques are formed by the erosive action of glaciers, which pluck and abrade the rock surface. Cirques are often found at the head of valleys, and are often filled with lakes or glaciers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** **Lagoon:**

 
• A lagoon is a shallow body of water separated from a larger body of water by a narrow strip of land.
 
• Lagoons are typically formed when a barrier island or coral reef forms parallel to the shore, creating a sheltered area of water.
 
• Lagoons are often found along coastlines, particularly in tropical and subtropical regions.

 

**Kayal:**

 
• A kayal is a type of lagoon found in the coastal regions of India, particularly in the state of Kerala.
 
• Kayals are typically formed when a river meets the sea, creating a brackish water ecosystem. 
 
• Kayals are often home to a variety of plants and animals, and are important for fishing and other economic activities.

 

**Beach:**

 

 
• A beach is a gently sloping area of sand or other sediment found along the shoreline of a body of water, such as an ocean or lake.
 
• Beaches are formed by the action of waves and currents, which erode and transport sediment from the shoreline.
 
• Beaches are popular recreational areas, and are also important for wildlife habitat.

 

**Therefore,** 

the correct answer is **Cirque**, as it is the only landscape on the list that is not formed by the sea-water

questions.question: What is a fundamental function of Centriole in a cell?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Cell division initiation**__.

__
 
• **Cell division initiation** is the fundamental function of Centriole in a cell.
 
• The centrioles help in the formation of the spindle fibers that separate the chromosomes during cell division.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Centrioles are the feature of animal cells. They are absent in plant cells.
 
• Centrioles are the cell component that is visible during the cell division stages.
 
• Centrioles are the microtubule producing organelles engaged in cell division.
 
• It is situated near the nucleus in the cytoplasm.
 
• The Centrioles help in the formation of spindle fibers during cell division.
 
• Animal cells are devoid of the following:
 
 
• Cell wall
 
• Large Vacuole
 
• Plastids
 
• Plasmodesmata

questions.question: Bone in most big animals is an example of which of the following tissues?
questions.solution:
• Bone in most big animals is an example of **Connective tissues.**
 
• **Connective tissue (CT)** is one of the four basic types of animal tissue along with epithelial tissue, muscle tissue, and nervous tissue.
 
• Connective tissue is found in between other tissues everywhere in the body, including the nervous system.

questions.question: Ascaris a kind of worm lives in which part of the human body?
questions.solution:

• Ascaris is the most common **human worm **infection. The larvae and adult worms live in the small intestine and can cause intestinal disease.
